title: What Information Buys in Active Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.19046v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Information-theoretic exploration is of primary interest in methodological studies of reinforcement learning (RL) and computational cognitive neuroscience, while the established RL theory builds regret guarantees on confidence sets. This situation leaves open the conditions under which the information-driven exploration found in nature is more advantageous than the exploration of the established RL theory. We put the state-of-the-art methods of these two paradigms, Active Inference (AIF) and Bayes-UCBVI, on an equal footing: both act through the same state abstraction of a tabular MDP with $S$ states, and their greedy forms differ only in the exploration term. We find that AIF's information gain decays too fast to serve as a confidence width, locking greedy agents that explore by it out of the optimal action. translated_title: 主动推理中信息能换来什么
translated_abstract: 信息论式的探索是强化学习（RL）方法学研究与计算认知神经科学的主要关注点，而成熟的强化学习理论则基于置信集来构建后悔保证。这种情况留下了一个悬而未决的问题：在何种条件下，自然界中存在的信息驱动探索比成熟强化学习理论的探索更具优势。我们将这两种范式中最先进的方法——主动推理（AIF）与 Bayes-UCBVI——置于同一起跑线上：二者都通过同一个针对具有 $S$ 个状态的表格型 MDP 的状态抽象来行动，且它们的贪婪形式仅在探索项上有所差别。我们发现 AIF 的信息增益衰减得过快，无法充当置信宽度，这使得依赖它进行探索的贪婪智能体被锁定在无法选择最优动作的状态。通过对信息增益进行平方根校准，我们得到了校准后的 AIF（calibrated AIF），它在精确的情况下达到了 $\sqrt T$ 阶的后悔界。
tldr: 本文将主动推理（AIF）与贝叶斯UCBVI置于相同的MDP状态抽象下进行对比，发现AIF的信息增益衰减过快导致探索不足，进而通过对信息增益进行平方根校准，使校准后的AIF达到了√T阶的后悔界。
en_tdlr: By comparing Active Inference (AIF) with Bayes-UCBVI under the same state abstraction of a tabular MDP, this paper shows that AIF's information gain decays too fast to serve as a confidence width, and a square-root calibration yields calibrated AIF that achieves √T-order regret.
